budget_items.what_was_recorded: The most recent Comcast offer, received the day before, included a capital grant over 10 years, which the committee said does not meet its needs.

budget_items.topic: License fee and franchise fee structure
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee explained that the license fee is a percentage of gross annual revenue and the franchise fee covers all other costs, including capital.
budget_items.quote: the license fee is the percentage of gross annual revenue and then the franchise fee is all other costs and includes capital.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Franks said that giving $240K would require reducing the franchise fee to 1%.
budget_items.quote: if i give you $240k i would have to reduce franchise fee to 1%

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Hewig said the Town is asking to go from $.24 to $.60, a small amount.
budget_items.quote: we are asking to go from $.24 to $.60, which is a small amount.

budget_items.topic: Increase in percentage fee over license
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Franks said the increase in the percentage fee equates to two million over the course of the license.
budget_items.quote: the increase in the percentage fee equates to two million over the course of the license.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Alonzo said Comcast is making about 32 million per year on Lunenburg subscribers.
budget_items.quote: comcast is making about 32 million per year on lunenburg subscribers.

budget_items.topic: Gap between Town request and Comcast offer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee said the difference between its request and Comcast's offer equates to $11,000 per year.
budget_items.quote: the difference between what we are requesting and what comcast is offering equates to $11,000 per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The pass-through cost to a subscriber is about .32 cents on a monthly bill.
budget_items.quote: the pass through cost to the subscriber is actually about .32 cents on a monthly bill.
